summary: Reports results from testing NETBLT over three networks with different bandwidths and round-trip delays. The results were incomplete and, so far, not promising. It assumes the reader knows the NETBLT specification in RFC 998.

eli5.summary: Someone tried a new fast way of sending big files across three different kinds of roads. So far it didn't work as well as hoped.

questions: how did netblt perform in tests
what were the results of testing netblt
